summary: ENDRA Life Sciences filed an 8-K disclosing the First Amendment to its June 25, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with ASP Isotopes (ASPI), Noble Africa LLC, Renergen Limited and Kruger Merger Sub LLC. Merger Sub will merge into Noble, which survives as an ENDRA subsidiary, with ENDRA issuing stock to ASPI holders. The amendment permits warrant amendments with ASP affiliate LHE LNG, removes the classified board, sets minimum closing cash at $3,800,002.59, replaces the Fifth Amended Certificate, and raises Renergen borrowing capacity from $80M to $120M. No per-share price, premium or fixed closing date is given. Watch Nasdaq listing, cash condition and financing addenda.
